This is Google's announcement page for Gemini 4 Argon, shared on Hacker News. The page itself was not retrieved, so this summary rests on the feed item and related coverage in the same pass: Google has begun rolling out the model, first to a small group of trusted cyber-defense partners, and says it takes part in the US government's voluntary pre-release process.

The Hacker News thread points to Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation of the model as the companion discussion.
highlights: Google's own announcement of Gemini 4 Argon
Rollout starts with trusted cyber defenders (per Axios coverage)
Google joins the US voluntary pre-release process
Linked to the Artificial Analysis evaluation thread
Basis: feed item only, page not retrieved
